bagPolicy.summary: Oversized bags, backpacks, duffel bags and diaper bags are prohibited; the FAQ does not specify a numeric size limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Free parking is available within walking distance; limited spaces directly beside the theater normally cost $10 or more and are first come, first served.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Tulsa Theater FAQ does not designate a rideshare pickup area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Two lower-level bars sell beer, wine, spirits, soft drinks and water; a balcony concession opens for full-theater shows. Outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue FAQ does not publish a specific step-free entrance or accessible seating procedure.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Once a ticket is scanned, guests cannot leave and re-enter.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect hardcopy Will Call tickets at the venue box office on the event day from noon or during regular box-office hours. The buyer must show photo ID and the matching purchasing credit card.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors normally open one hour before the performance unless the event or ticket says otherwise.
